title: Bicystar high chairs sold without the crotch restraint
hazard: The chair was sold without the crotch restraint the safety standard requires. A child can slide down and be caught by the neck, or the chair can tip.
action: Stop using it. Take the seat off the frame, cut the seat cover and the straps, write "Recalled" on the back of the seat, and email a photo to bicystarhighchair@outlook.com for a full refund.

source.title: Bicystar High Chairs Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall and Entrapment Hazards

title: Rotinyard convertible high chairs sold without the restraint system
product: Rotinyard convertible high chair, product number HA-028, sold on Amazon
hazard: The chair was sold without the attached restraint system the safety standard requires. A child can fall out, or be caught between the seat and the tray.
action: Stop using it. Take it apart, cut the restraints and the cushion, and email a photo to trailblazeramz@outlook.com for a full refund.

source.title: Convertible High Chairs Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fall and Entrapment Hazards

title: Voomf play yard and crib mattresses that may not fit
product: Voomf play yard and crib mattress, model BYL001, sold on Amazon
hazard: The mattress may leave a gap against the side of some play yards, which is where a baby can become trapped. The full-size crib version also fails the flammability standard.
action: Stop using it. Write "Recalled" on it, cut it in half, and email a photo to voomfrecall@outlook.com for a full refund.

source.title: Play Yard and Crib Mattresses Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Fire Hazards

title: Anna Queen play yards a baby can get under the mattress of
product: Anna Queen play yard, model P700, made in March 2025, sold on Amazon
hazard: A baby can get trapped under the mattress or between the mattress and the side of the play yard, which can cause suffocation.
action: Stop using it. Take it apart, cut up the cover and the mattress pad, and email a photo to tingerservice@outlook.com for a full refund.

source.title: Play Yards Recalled Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Suffocation and Entrapment Hazards

title: Hoovy cooling gel pads for car seats and strollers can burn
product: Hoovy cooling gel insert pad for car seats and strollers
hazard: The pad can get hot enough to burn a child if it is left in the sun or in a warm car, and a young child may not be able to move away from it.
action: Stop using it. Contact AMTRADING at 888-259-1411 or info@hoovyproducts.com for a full refund, or register the pad at hoovyproducts.com/pages/product-recall.

source.title: AMTRADING Recalls Hoovy Cooling Gel Insert Pads for Car Seats and Strollers Due to Burn Hazard
